bagPolicy.summary: For quick entry, fans are encouraged to leave bags at home. Small clutches, crossbody bags, and clear bags are allowed, while standard backpacks are not permitted.
bagPolicy.note: Purses, medical bags, and diaper bags must meet NBA size requirements of 14” x 14” x 6” and are subject to additional screening.

parking.note: Valet parking is available starting 2 hours prior to events, and the attached five-story, 700-space parking structure offers convenient parking for suite holders. Several other parking garages and lots are within walking distance.

rideshare.note: Lyft Drop Off Locations: 1st Street/Jefferson, S 2nd Street, S 3rd Street, E Jefferson Street. Lyft Pick Up Location: S 3rd Street & E Jefferson Street.

concessions.note: The Mortgage Matchup Center offers a variety of food and beverage options catering to different dietary preferences, including vegetarian and gluten-free choices. However, specific details about the offerings are not provided.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: If you have difficulty navigating stairs but do not need a wheelchair accessible location, row 20 in the 100 level and row 2 in the 200 level do not require taking stairs. Accessible parking spaces are located on floors 1-5 near elevators, available as first-come, first-served.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Mortgage Matchup Center's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The Mortgage Matchup Center ticket office will be open at 3pm on weekday events and three (3) hours prior to event time for weekends.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Mortgage Matchup Center. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
